name: django-crispy-forms-field-targeted-fragment-043b
instr:
crispy-forms cannot render arbitrary form or formset subsets without losing crispy layout semantics. Add field-targeted fragment rendering for Python and Django templates. Expose `FieldIdentity` and `RenderSelection` from `crispy_forms.selection`, `RenderFragment` and `render_crispy_fragment` from `crispy_forms.fragments`, `FragmentSelectionError` from `crispy_forms.exceptions`, `RenderScope` from `crispy_forms.render_scope`, and `crispy_fragment` from `crispy_forms.templatetags.crispy_forms_tags`. `FragmentSelectionError` is a CrispyError. Rendering without an active selection must remain observationally unchanged.

Canonicalize names and formset indexes in first-request order, deduplicate identical identities, allow empty selections, and expose them through `identities`. Return safe HTML with deterministic, disjoint `rendered`, `unavailable`, and `suppressed` partitions. Strict completion raises `FragmentSelectionError` carrying every unavailable request. Nested scopes account independently and restore context after success or failure.

Resolve live helper layouts at render time. Emit selected entries in layout order and fallback-render only selected eligible omissions. Retain containers only where selected descendants require composition; standalone HTML requires explicit selection. Bootstrap `PrependedAppendedText`, `FieldWithButtons`, and inactive `Tab` must preserve grouping, control suppression, and errored-field activation. Support compact and verbose helper/template-
